reviews.text: What a great experience I had with Mike from Complete Chimney. He was such a nice person, very polite and extremely tidy. My chimney needed a cleaning really bad. My pellet stove is now burning cleaner, hotter and more efficient. I would highly recommend!
reviews.author: Audry R.

reviews.text: Professional, Knowledgeable, Informative & Personable are just a few words to describe Mike, owner/operator of Complete Chimney Service. Today was the first time we met and employed his services and it most certainly will not be the last.
reviews.author: Kenny C.

reviews.text: We recently had our both of our wood stoves chimney’s cleaned and Mike did a great job. He was knowledgeable, helpful, prompt, personable and professional. He was very thorough in his inspection of our chimneys giving us peace of mind for the winter!
reviews.author: Sarah W.
